main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise. Perth's primary winter metropolitan venue. A well-drained 1,699m oval featuring a relatively short 333-metre home straight. On Good to Soft tracks, the short straight heavily rewards front-runners ('E') and box-seat stalkers ('P'). On heavily rain-affected winter tracks, the inside rail breaks down, causing jockeys to fan wide into the straight searching for the 'Fast Lane' down the center or outside fence.
main_turf.post_bias: In 1000m and 1200m sprints, inside barriers (stalls 1-5) hold a distinct advantage due to the quick arrival of the home turn. Wide draws (8+) are heavily penalized if trapped 3-wide without cover. In 1400m and 1600m races starting in the backstretch chute, the longer straightaway run allows wide barriers a much fairer chance to find cover.

handicapping_angles.short_333m_straight_leader_boost: On Good to Soft surfaces, waiting until the 200m mark to make a challenge is usually too late. Aggressively upgrade horses with proven gate speed ('E') and jockeys who make proactive, early moves prior to the home bend.
handicapping_angles.wet_track_outside_lane_migration: During Perth's wet winter months (June-August), when the track drops to Soft 7 or Heavy, watch the early races. If jockeys begin steering 4-8 paths off the inside rail in the straight, upgrade wide-drawn closers and horses adapting to the outside 'Fast Lane'.
handicapping_angles.the_ascot_to_belmont_transition: Belmont's sand-drained surface handles winter rain far better than Ascot. Upgrade horses that struggled on wet, glop surfaces at Ascot but possess high baseline ratings and sound wet-track pedigree.
handicapping_angles.wa_rtg_benchmark_weight_penalty: In WA Ratings-Based Handicaps (RTG 66+, RTG 72+, RTG 78+), top-weight runners carrying 59.5kg+ face a strict penalty (1kg = ~1 length over 333m). In WFA / Group feature races (Belmont Sprint, Hyperion, Strickland Stakes), ignore minor weight spreads and prioritize peak class ratings.
handicapping_angles.apprentice_claim_value: On Saturday metropolitan cards, elite 2kg/3kg claiming apprentices riding for top Perth stables (Parnham, Durrant, Williams) provide a massive tactical edge by dropping heavy weights down to competitive 54kg-56kg brackets.
